titleEn: Minimum String Length After Removing Substrings
title: 删除子串后的字符串最小长度
summary: 可反复删除字符串中的 AB 或 CD，求最终能达到的最小长度。
insight: 从左到右用栈保存尚未消除字符。当前字符若是 B 且栈顶 A，或是 D 且栈顶 C，就弹栈完成一次删除；否则入栈。新相邻关系会立刻在后续处理中被检查。
pitfalls: 删除后左右字符会重新相邻
只能删除顺序完全匹配的 AB、CD

solutions.title: 栈消除 AB 与 CD
solutions.idea: 在线维护删除后的字符串前缀。
steps: 若栈非空且 (top=A,current=B) 或 (top=C,current=D)，弹栈

code.java: class Solution { public int minLength(String s){char[] stack=new char[s.length()];int size=0;for(char current:s.toCharArray()){if(size>0&&(stack[size-1]=='A'&&current=='B'||stack[size-1]=='C'&&current=='D'))size--;else stack[size++]=current;}return size;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minLength(s:String):Int{val stack=CharArray(s.length);var size=0;for(current in s){if(size>0&&(stack[size-1]=='A'&&current=='B'||stack[size-1]=='C'&&current=='D'))size-- else stack[size++]=current};return size} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minLength(string s){string stack;for(char current:s){if(!stack.empty()&&((stack.back()=='A'&&current=='B')||(stack.back()=='C'&&current=='D')))stack.pop_back();else stack.push_back(current);}return stack.size();} };
